question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank number 2.
solution:
The correct answer is "**confused**".

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Let's look at the meaning of the given words:
 
 
• **challenged**: used to indicate that someone or something is lacking or deficient in specified respect.
 
• **confused**: (of a person) unable to think clearly; bewildered.
 
• **decreased**: make or become smaller or fewer in size, amount, intensity, or degree.
 
• **amazed**: greatly surprised; astonished.
 
 
 
• ​As per the meaning of the given words, "**confused**" is the appropriate word choice for the blank.
 
• The implied meaning of the given sentence is that success is misunderstood as having material wealth by amassing millions and billions.

Hence, the correct answer is **option 2.**

**The complete passage is: **Although everyone wants to be successful in life, there are*** (1) a few ***people who know the elements of success, the factors that go to build up success. Today, success is being*** (2) confused ***with making money, with amassing millions and billions. Some people equate it with power and position. Many of us tend to equate success with visible material acquisitions. Outer things and external achievements are not a ***(***__***3***__***)***__***measure*** of success. Power, prestige, position, social influence and higher degrees awarded by universities - all these are outer things. They only touch the fringe of life; they do not enter the depths within. A man may have all these and yet maybe intellectually barren; he may be emotionally barren and spiritually sterile. Would you call such a man*** (4) successful***? What then is success all about? What is true success? Success can be defined as the ability to be happy and make others happy; the ability to love and be loved; the ability to remain in peaceful ***(5) harmony*** with oneself; with those around you and with God's cosmic laws.
